question: Which couple broke up two weeks after finally confirming they were together?
story: Role Model finally confirmed he was dating Dakota Johnson, and fifteen days later the breakup was public. According to TMZ and E News, the two split after less than a year together, and sources say it actually happened a while before the news broke on August nineteenth. Here is the timing that made everyone do a double take. On August fourth, Role Model, whose real name is Tucker Pillsbury, gave an interview to Nylon talking about her cameo on his song Love I You. He reportedly said he hesitated about mixing work and a relationship, then described her standing right up, walking into the booth, and nailing it better than they could have imagined. That was August fourth. Two weeks later, reports say they were done. Romance rumors first started back in December of twenty twenty five, not long after the end of her seven year relationship with Coldplay's Chris Martin. No reason for the split has been reported. Just the calendar.
